rules.name: Elevated CO2
rules.recommendation: Review the CO2 removal subsystem and verify the reading.
rules.explanation: The CO2 value exceeded the configurable demonstration threshold.

rules.name: Elevated CO2 with scrubber inactive
rules.recommendation: Inspect the CO2 removal subsystem and independently verify scrubber status.
rules.explanation: Both elevated CO2 and inactive scrubber conditions were detected.

rules.name: Low cabin pressure
rules.recommendation: Verify pressure sensor validity and inspect the pressure-control subsystem.
rules.explanation: Cabin pressure is below the illustrative configured threshold.

rules.name: Low oxygen partial pressure
rules.recommendation: Verify oxygen measurements and review life-support subsystem status.
rules.explanation: Oxygen partial pressure is below the illustrative configured threshold.

rules.name: Elevated radiation indicator
rules.recommendation: Verify the radiation sensor and review the mission's approved radiation procedures.
rules.explanation: Radiation indicator exceeded the illustrative demonstration threshold.

rules.name: Sensor offline
rules.recommendation: Check device power, communication link, and sensor diagnostics.
rules.explanation: At least one monitored sensor reports OFFLINE.

rules.name: Elevated crew heart-rate indicator
rules.recommendation: Verify the measurement and refer the observation to qualified medical personnel.
rules.explanation: Heart-rate indicator exceeded the illustrative demonstration threshold; this is not a diagnosis.

rules.name: Low SpO2 indicator
rules.recommendation: Verify sensor placement and measurement; seek qualified medical review.
rules.explanation: SpO2 indicator is below the illustrative demonstration threshold; this is not a diagnosis.

rules.name: Telemetry quality flag
rules.recommendation: Do not rely on the affected telemetry until data quality is restored.
rules.explanation: The telemetry producer marked the current data set invalid.
